passage: Standing behind the backstage curtain of the municipal concert hall, Daniel felt his palms grow damp as the murmur of the audience swelled beyond the velvet folds. For six months, he had practiced the violin concerto until his fingers ached, yet tonight marked his first solo performance with a full symphony orchestra. When the concertmaster tuned the strings and the conductor raised his baton, Daniel's heartbeat seemed to drown out the opening chords. Taking a slow, deliberate breath, he stepped onto the brightly lit stage and lifted his bow to the strings. As the first clear, resonant notes filled the auditorium, his nervousness melted into pure focus, and his fingers moved effortlessly across the fingerboard, carried by months of patient preparation.
question: 다음 글에 드러난 Daniel의 심경 변화로 가장 적절한 것은?
explanation: 구문: 'felt his palms grow damp ~ Daniel's heartbeat seemed to drown out the opening chords'에서 긴장되고 불안한(anxious) 심경이 드러나고, 'his nervousness melted into pure focus, and his fingers moved effortlessly'에서 몰입한(absorbed) 상태로 변화했습니다.
